CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transition_indicator_rollout(p_mode indicator_rollout_mode, p_epoch uuid, p_target indicator_rollout_mode)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
    DECLARE c public.indicator_rollout_control%ROWTYPE;
      guard public.indicator_source_guard%ROWTYPE; observed timestamptz; ready_count integer;
    BEGIN
      IF p_mode IS NULL OR p_epoch IS NULL OR p_target IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','REJECTED'); END IF;
      -- Publication lock order. Never obtain relation locks under this guard.
      SELECT * INTO STRICT guard FROM public.indicator_source_guard WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE;
      SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.indicator_rollout_control WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE;
      IF c.transition_from_mode=p_mode AND c.transition_from_epoch=p_epoch
        AND c.transition_target=p_target AND c.mode=p_target::text THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','ALREADY_APPLIED','epoch',c.rollout_epoch,
          'cutoff',c.last_v2_issue_cutoff); END IF;
      IF c.mode<>p_mode::text OR c.rollout_epoch<>p_epoch THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','STALE'); END IF;
      IF NOT ((p_mode='LEGACY' AND p_target='PREPARING')
        OR (p_mode='PREPARING' AND p_target IN ('PREPARED','PAUSED'))
        OR (p_mode='PREPARED' AND p_target='PAUSED')
        OR (p_mode='PAUSED' AND p_target='PREPARING')) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','REJECTED'); END IF;
      PERFORM 1 FROM public.indicator_build_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE;
      IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_build_slot WHERE id=1 AND state='IDLE')
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_build_jobs WHERE status='RUNNING')
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory'
          AND classid=711 AND objid=1 AND objsubid=2 AND granted
          AND database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()))
        THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','NOT_DRAINED'); END IF;
      -- Pausing must remain possible when proof/configuration is broken.
      IF p_target<>'PAUSED' AND (c.protocol_version<>1 OR c.codec_version<>2
        OR c.source_proof_state<>'READY' OR c.retention_policy<>'GRACE'
        OR NOT public.indicator_source_triggers_valid()
        OR NOT (coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_guard'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_changes'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_rollout_control'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_guard'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_changes'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.indicator_rollout_control'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_market_data',to_regclass('public.indicator_rollout_control'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.market_candles'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.market_candles'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_ready_generations'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_ready_checkpoints'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_ready_heads'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_numeric_failures'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regprocedure('public.indicator_source_triggers_valid()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.indicator_source_triggers_valid()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_market_data',to_regprocedure('public.begin_indicator_source_write()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_market_data',to_regprocedure('public.require_indicator_source_write()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.try_indicator_build_lock()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.unlock_indicator_build_lock()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.seed_indicator_build_jobs()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.claim_indicator_build_job(uuid)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.heartbeat_indicator_build_claim(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.release_indicator_build_claim(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.initialize_indicator_staging(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,timestamptz,uuid,bigint)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.append_indicator_checkpoint(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,timestamptz,jsonb)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.seal_indicator_staging(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.publish_indicator_ready(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.publish_indicator_numeric_failure(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.coalesce_indicator_build_jobs()'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.retry_indicator_build_job(uuid,uuid)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.gc_indicator_data()'),'EXECUTE'),false))) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'); END IF;
      observed:=clock_timestamp();
      IF p_target='PREPARED' THEN
        SELECT count(*) INTO ready_count FROM public.indicator_build_jobs j
          JOIN public.indicator_heads h USING(source,base,quote,timeframe,formula_version)
          JOIN public.indicator_generations g ON g.id=h.generation_id
          WHERE j.formula_version='indicators-v2' AND g.status='READY'
            AND g.source=j.source AND g.base=j.base AND g.quote=j.quote
            AND g.timeframe=j.timeframe AND g.formula_version=j.formula_version
            AND g.codec_version=2 AND g.dataset_revision IS NOT NULL
            AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.indicator_checkpoints cp
              WHERE cp.generation_id=g.id)=g.checkpoint_count
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_checkpoints cp
              WHERE cp.generation_id=g.id AND cp.next_open_at=g.calculation_start)
            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_checkpoints cp
              WHERE cp.generation_id=g.id AND cp.next_open_at=g.calculation_end)
            AND g.expires_at>observed AND g.as_of<=observed
            AND g.as_of>=observed-interval '600 seconds'
            AND g.source_epoch=guard.epoch
            AND g.source_fence BETWEEN guard.journal_floor AND guard.revision
            AND (j.failed_calculation_key IS NULL OR g.candidate_sequence>=j.generation_sequence)
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_source_changes e
              WHERE e.epoch=guard.epoch AND e.revision>g.source_fence
                AND (e.kind='RESET' OR (e.source=g.source AND e.base=g.base AND e.quote=g.quote
                  AND e.timeframe=g.timeframe AND e.open_at>=g.calculation_start
                  AND e.open_at<g.calculation_end)));
        IF ready_count<>40 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','HEADS_NOT_READY'); END IF;
      END IF;
      UPDATE public.indicator_rollout_control SET mode=p_target::text,
        rollout_epoch=CASE WHEN p_mode='LEGACY' THEN rollout_epoch ELSE gen_random_uuid() END,
        active_cursor_format=CASE WHEN p_target='PREPARED' THEN 2 ELSE active_cursor_format END,
        last_v2_issue_cutoff=CASE WHEN p_target='PAUSED' AND p_mode='PREPARED'
          THEN observed ELSE last_v2_issue_cutoff END,
        transition_from_mode=p_mode,transition_from_epoch=p_epoch,transition_target=p_target
        WHERE id=1 RETURNING * INTO c;
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','APPLIED','epoch',c.rollout_epoch,
        'cutoff',c.last_v2_issue_cutoff);
    END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transition_indicator_rollout(p_mode indicator_rollout_mode, p_epoch uuid, p_target indicator_rollout_mode)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
    DECLARE c public.indicator_rollout_control%ROWTYPE;
      guard public.indicator_source_guard%ROWTYPE; observed timestamptz; ready_count integer;
    BEGIN
      IF p_mode IS NULL OR p_epoch IS NULL OR p_target IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','REJECTED'); END IF;
      -- Publication lock order. Never obtain relation locks under this guard.
      SELECT * INTO STRICT guard FROM public.indicator_source_guard WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE;
      SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.indicator_rollout_control WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE;
      IF c.transition_from_mode=p_mode AND c.transition_from_epoch=p_epoch
        AND c.transition_target=p_target AND c.mode=p_target::text THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','ALREADY_APPLIED','epoch',c.rollout_epoch,
          'cutoff',c.last_v2_issue_cutoff); END IF;
      IF c.mode<>p_mode::text OR c.rollout_epoch<>p_epoch THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','STALE'); END IF;
      IF NOT ((p_mode='LEGACY' AND p_target='PREPARING')
        OR (p_mode='PREPARING' AND p_target IN ('PREPARED','PAUSED'))
        OR (p_mode='PREPARED' AND p_target='PAUSED')
        OR (p_mode='PAUSED' AND p_target='PREPARING')) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','REJECTED'); END IF;
      PERFORM 1 FROM public.indicator_build_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE;
      IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_build_slot WHERE id=1 AND state='IDLE')
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.indicator_build_jobs WHERE status='RUNNING')
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory'
          AND classid=711 AND objid=1 AND objsubid=2 AND granted
          AND database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()))
        THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','NOT_DRAINED'); END IF;
      -- Pausing must remain possible when proof/configuration is broken.
      IF p_target<>'PAUSED' AND (c.protocol_version<>1 OR c.codec_version<>2
        OR c.source_proof_state<>'READY' OR c.retention_policy<>'GRACE'
        OR NOT public.indicator_source_triggers_valid()
        OR NOT (coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_guard'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_changes'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.indicator_rollout_control'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_guard'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.indicator_source_changes'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_market_data',to_regclass('public.indicator_rollout_control'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regclass('public.market_candles'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_table_privilege('tiewtrade_api',to_regclass('public.market_candles'),'SELECT'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.seal_indicator_staging(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND coalesce(has_function_privilege('tiewtrade_indicator_builder',to_regprocedure('public.publish_indicator_ready(uuid,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'),'EXECUTE'),false) AND         RETURN jsonb_build_object('result','POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'); END IF;
      observed:=clock_timestamp();
      IF p_target='PREPARED' THEN
        SELECT count(*) INTO ready_count FROM public.indicator_build_jobs j
          JOIN public.indicator_heads h USING(source,base,quote,timeframe,formula_version)

        rollout_epoch=CASE WHEN p_mode='LEGACY' THEN rollout_epoch ELSE gen_random_uuid() END,
